weights: [out,in]; merged QKV consists of complete Q, K, V segments
head_mapping: contiguous head blocks within each Q/K/V segment
float_mask: input dtype; additive; -inf allowed; NaN/+inf rejected
empty_row: zero probability/context and core gradient; output projection bias may remain
positional_bias: finite input-dtype additive bias applied after scaling
rope: optional adjacent even/odd pair rotation, theta=position/base^(2*pair/rotary_dim)
position_ids: nonnegative integer S or B,S; defaults to arange(S)
rotary_dim: positive even integer <= head_dim; suffix unchanged
dropout: attention probabilities only; p in [0,1); inverted scaling; disabled in eval
fixed_dropout_mask: boolean True=keep; only accepted in training with p>0
compute_dtype: same as input and parameter dtype
softmax_dtype: same as input by default; optional float32/float64; probabilities cast to input dtype
